nodes.label: React Native Skills Guide (v1.0.0)
nodes.rationale: Performance guide optimized for AI agents; 35+ rules across 13 categories prioritized by impact

nodes.label: Core Rendering (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Violations cause runtime crashes or broken UI

nodes.label: Never Use && with Potentially Falsy Values
nodes.rationale: Falsy '' or 0 rendered outside <Text> crashes RN in production; prefer ternary/early return

nodes.label: Wrap Strings in Text Components
nodes.rationale: Strings as direct View children crash

nodes.label: Avoid Inline Objects in renderItem
nodes.rationale: Inline objects create new refs each render, breaking memo

nodes.label: Hoist Callbacks to the Root of Lists
Keep List Items Lightweight
nodes.rationale: Expensive items cause jank during virtualized scroll; no queries, minimal hooks, Zustand selectors over Context

nodes.label: Optimize List Performance with Stable Object References
nodes.rationale: Virtualization relies on reference stability; mapping data re-renders all visible items

nodes.label: Pass Primitives to List Items for Memoization
nodes.rationale: Primitives enable shallow comparison in memo()

nodes.label: Use a List Virtualizer for Any List
nodes.rationale: ScrollView mounts all children upfront

nodes.label: Use Compressed Images in Lists
nodes.rationale: Full-res images cost memory and cause jank; request 2x display size

nodes.label: Use Item Types for Heterogeneous Lists
nodes.rationale: Separate recycling pools per type avoid layout thrashing

nodes.label: Animate Transform and Opacity Instead of Layout Properties
nodes.rationale: transform/opacity are GPU-accelerated; layout props recalc layout every frame

nodes.label: Prefer useDerivedValue Over useAnimatedReaction
nodes.rationale: Derived values are declarative with auto dependency tracking; reactions are for side effects

nodes.label: Use GestureDetector for Animated Press States
nodes.rationale: Gesture callbacks run as UI-thread worklets, no JS round-trip

nodes.label: Never Track Scroll Position in useState
nodes.rationale: Scroll events fire rapidly; state updates cause render thrashing

nodes.label: Use Native Navigators for Navigation
nodes.rationale: Native navigators use platform APIs (UINavigationController, Fragment) for performance and native behavior

nodes.label: Minimize State Variables and Derive Values
nodes.rationale: Redundant state causes re-renders and drift

nodes.label: Use Fallback State Instead of initialState
nodes.rationale: undefined = user hasn't chosen; ?? fallback stays reactive to prop/server changes

nodes.label: useState Dispatch Updaters for State Depending on Current Value
nodes.rationale: Avoids stale closures; returning prev skips re-render

nodes.label: State Must Represent Ground Truth
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth; visuals derived via interpolation; easier to extend and debug

nodes.label: Destructure Functions Early in Render
nodes.rationale: Compiler keys cache on objects that change each render when dotting in

nodes.label: Use .get()/.set() for Reanimated Shared Values
nodes.rationale: Compiler cannot track .value property access

nodes.label: Measuring View Dimensions
nodes.rationale: useLayoutEffect sync measure + onLayout updates

nodes.label: Modern React Native Styling Patterns
nodes.rationale: borderCurve continuous, gap, CSS boxShadow, experimental_backgroundImage gradients, limited font sizes

nodes.label: Use contentInset for Dynamic ScrollView Spacing
nodes.rationale: contentInset avoids layout recalculation

nodes.label: Use contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior for Safe Areas
nodes.rationale: Native safe-area handling instead of SafeAreaView/manual padding

nodes.label: Use expo-image for Optimized Images
nodes.rationale: Memory-efficient caching, blurhash placeholders, progressive loading

nodes.label: Use Galeria for Image Galleries and Lightbox
nodes.rationale: Native shared element transitions, pinch/zoom

nodes.label: Use Native Menus for Dropdowns and Context Menus
nodes.rationale: Built-in accessibility and platform UX

nodes.label: Use Native Modals Over JS-Based Bottom Sheets
nodes.rationale: Built-in gestures, keyboard avoidance, accessibility

nodes.label: Use Pressable Instead of Touchable Components
Use Compound Components Over Polymorphic Children
nodes.rationale: Components receiving string children must be dedicated *Text components

nodes.label: Install Native Dependencies in App Directory
nodes.rationale: Autolinking only scans the app's node_modules

nodes.label: Use Single Dependency Versions Across Monorepo
nodes.rationale: Multiple versions duplicate bundles and cause runtime conflicts

nodes.label: Import from Design System Folder
nodes.rationale: Re-exporting enables global changes and easy refactoring

nodes.label: Hoist Intl Formatter Creation
nodes.rationale: Intl objects parse locale data and build lookup tables on instantiation

nodes.label: Load Fonts Natively at Build Time
nodes.rationale: Embedded fonts available at launch, no async loading

hyperedges.label: Prefer native platform primitives over JS reimplementations
UI-thread animation with ground-truth shared values
